title: createBook always returns 500 on store errors including constraint violations
evidence: server.go:82 maps every store.Create error to http.StatusInternalServerError; a duplicate/constraint failure would surface as 500 rather than 409/400
suggestion: Distinguish constraint errors from internal failures if unique constraints are added later

title: PUT is full-replace and requires title+author, no PATCH semantics
evidence: server.go:121 updateBook reuses decodeBook which rejects blank title/author; partial updates are not supported
suggestion: Acceptable for the spec (PUT = full replace); document if partial update is ever desired
